datasets.title: Flooding in the Philippines on October 03, 2024
datasets.description: This dataset shows the actual extent of flooding in the Philippines caused by typhoons or tropical cyclones as of October 03, 2024, as observed through available satellite imagery. The dataset can be used to track the progression of floods over time, identify areas at risk, and assess the impact of these natural disasters on infrastructure, agriculture, and local populations.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/philippines-flood-20241003]
datasets.details: This dataset has not been validated using ground-truth data.

lineage.description: Satellite imagery (optical and SAR) acquired on October 3, 2024 was processed by the Philippine Space Agency to delineate observed flood extent polygons. The resulting vector and raster datasets represent the actual spatial distribution of inundation caused by typhoon-induced rainfall and storm surge, enabling post-event hazard mapping and impact assessment.

sources.name: Philippine Space Agency
sources.description: Satellite image processing and analysis to delineate actual flood extent boundaries from optical and synthetic aperture radar imagery during the October 3, 2024 typhoon event
